parsed.rationale: One participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production method in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Consolidating these two would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app demonstration semantics. The correct resolution is to leave the WallpaperSampleApp copy as a self-contained local implementation within the sample app, not to extract it into shared production code.
